title: Extract Annual NLCD land cover percent and area for polygons — extract_nlcd
text: year Integer, 1985 2025. geometry sf/sfc object, terra::SpatVector, path vector file sf::st_read() can open. Polygons . Must fall within CONUS. units Area units: one "ha", "km2", "m2", "acres", "mi2". id Optional column name geometry use feature id. Defaults row number. wide TRUE, return one row per feature pct_<class> area_<class> columns (class colors attr(x, "nlcd_colors")). Default FALSE returns long (tidy) format. cache_dir Directory cached tiles. Defaults persistent user cache (tools::R_user_dir("fastnlcd", "cache")). chunk_size Features per chunk. Lower memory tight. cores Worker processes extraction (forked; Unix/macOS , ignored Windows). Tiles always downloaded parallel. quiet Suppress progress messages.

title: Extract Annual NLCD land cover percent and area for polygons — extract_nlcd
text: data.frame. Long format columns: id, year, class, description, nlcd_color (official NLCD hex color), area (units), pct (0-100, feature's area valid NLCD data). Classes absent feature omitted.

title: Extract Annual NLCD land cover percent and area for polygons — extract_nlcd
text: Speed comes four things: native 30 m tiles touching features requested USGS WCS. Nothing national downloaded. Tiles fetched parallel (HTTP/2 multiplexing via curl) cached disk, repeat calls years area instant near instant. Requests snapped NLCD grid, resampling happens. Extraction uses exact pixel coverage fractions (exactextractr, C++). Memory stays flat large layers: features sorted spatially run chunks chunk_size, chunk reads tiles lazy VRT, per-feature cell reads capped.
